# Low-Level Design (LLD)
## States
- IDLE, RINGING, ANSWERED, ON_HOLD, ENDED

## Transitions
- `start()`: IDLE -> RINGING
- `answer()`: RINGING -> ANSWERED
- `hold()`: ANSWERED -> ON_HOLD
- `end()`: ANY -> ENDED
